title: Read a checked planning record
responsibility: Assemble a plan with design versions, approvals and comment threads while checking stored artifact integrity.

inputs.name: approvalMatches.record
inputs.description: Approval record whose version, contract, notes and image bindings are compared.

inputs.name: planRead.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planRead.unitId
inputs.description: Unit ID whose plan is required.

outputs.name: approvalMatches
outputs.description: True when the approval exactly matches the latest version and selected option content; false when no matching version or option exists.

outputs.name: planRead
outputs.description: Plan detail with numerically ordered versions, approvals marked current, pinned-order threads, derived draft/review/approved lifecycle and counts; verified remains false.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects missing, corrupt, changed or mismatched artifacts, broken design sequences and rewritten message chains/history.
